Shore Staff Hybrid and Remote Work Policy (HR-POL-03)

raw_text: Shore-based office employees follow a 3-2 hybrid model with mandatory core in-office attendance on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week (Monday and Friday) with manager alignment.
contextual_text:
[Document: hybrid_and_remote_work_policy.pdf | Section: 1. Weekly Hybrid Schedule]
Shore-based office employees follow a 3-2 hybrid model with mandatory core in-office attendance on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week (Monday and Friday) with manager alignment.

raw_text: Eligible permanent shore staff receive a home-office ergonomics stipend of USD 600 every 24 months for monitors, chairs, or keyboards, reimbursed against itemized receipts.
contextual_text:
[Document: hybrid_and_remote_work_policy.pdf | Section: 2. Home-Office Equipment Stipend]
Eligible permanent shore staff receive a home-office ergonomics stipend of USD 600 every 24 months for monitors, chairs, or keyboards, reimbursed against itemized receipts.

raw_text: Shore staff may work remotely from abroad for up to 15 business days per calendar year, subject to written approval from both their line manager and HR at least 21 days in advance.
contextual_text:
[Document: hybrid_and_remote_work_policy.pdf | Section: 3. International Remote Work]
Shore staff may work remotely from abroad for up to 15 business days per calendar year, subject to written approval from both their line manager and HR at least 21 days in advance.

[Document: shore_leave_policy.pdf | Section: Introduction]
Shore Staff Leave Policy (HR-POL-01)

raw_text: Full-time shore-based office staff receive 22 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accruing monthly from the start date. Employees must submit annual leave requests in the HR portal at least 10 business days in advance for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days. Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the next calendar year, provided they are used before March 31. Unused carryover days expire on April 1 without cash payout.
contextual_text:
[Document: shore_leave_policy.pdf | Section: 1. Annual Leave Entitlement]
Full-time shore-based office staff receive 22 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accruing monthly from the start date. Employees must submit annual leave requests in the HR portal at least 10 business days in advance for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days. Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the next calendar year, provided they are used before March 31. Unused carryover days expire on April 1 without cash payout.

raw_text: Shore staff are granted 10 paid sick leave days per calendar year for personal illness or medical appointments. Any sick leave absence exceeding 3 consecutive working days requires a licensed physician's medical certificate uploaded to the HR portal within 48 hours of return.
contextual_text:
[Document: shore_leave_policy.pdf | Section: 2. Sick Leave]
Shore staff are granted 10 paid sick leave days per calendar year for personal illness or medical appointments. Any sick leave absence exceeding 3 consecutive working days requires a licensed physician's medical certificate uploaded to the HR portal within 48 hours of return.

raw_text: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave following birth or adoption; secondary caregivers receive 4 weeks of paid parental leave within the first 12 months. Bereavement leave of up to 5 paid working days is granted upon the death of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent, or sibling).

Shore Staff Travel and Expense Policy (HR-POL-02)

raw_text: All domestic and international flights under 6 hours must be booked in Economy class using the approved corporate travel portal at least 14 days before departure. Business class upgrades are permitted only on single flight legs exceeding 8 hours and require written Vice President (VP) approval prior to ticketing. Hotel lodging is capped at USD 220 per night excluding local taxes unless pre-approved for high-cost port cities.

section_title: 2. Daily Meal Per Diem and Receipts
raw_text: Shore staff on approved business travel receive a daily meal per diem cap of USD 65 per day. Alcohol and minibar charges are non-reimbursable. Itemized receipts are mandatory for any single expense exceeding USD 25.

raw_text: All expense claims must be submitted in the finance portal within 14 calendar days after returning from travel. Late claims exceeding 45 days require Finance Director sign-off.
